text:
alex: Quick sync — CustomerSuite POC asks: EU-only processing, vendor control-plane must remain in EU, BYOK (HSM), and notarized subproc snapshot. AE needs a compact decision brief. Who can help?

jo-ops: Ill scope ops. Clarify: tenant pinning vs full regional tenancy? Which is acceptable for POC?

alex: Tenant pinning is OK for POC but control-plane must not leave EU at any point.

nina-legal: If control-plane must be EU-hosted, standard hosted plan won't meet requirements unless we provision a Private control plane or special EU-only control plane. I can pull subproc list + SOC2 dates and prepare a notarized export and DPA addendum.

ralph-pricing: I can do numbers. Need QPS, token profile, model choice, POC duration.

eva-ml: Model note: 7B quant will be cheaper and lower latency; 13B increases infra needs. Share target model so I can add perf appendix.

jo-ops: Ops options to present:
- HOSTED+GEO_PIN: Data plane in EU, control-plane still multi-region — fastest (~2-3 business days).
- DEDICATED EU POOL: Reserved GPUs in EU; can combine with private control-plane; lead time ~2 weeks.
- PRIVATE EU CONTROL PLANE: Full EU residency, best for attestation; lead time 3-6 weeks and higher ops work.

infra-bot: Presales checklist snippet:
```nroute: "tenant_pin: eu-west-1"
control_plane: "eu_only: true"
kms: "BYOK-HSM: external, mTLS, cert_exchange"
fallback: "model_fallback: smaller-quant"
network: "ip_allowlist, peering, nat, egress_routes"
```
Include HSM cert stamping steps and acceptance test.

nina-legal: For BYOK-HSM we need keyflow diagram and confirmation that customer-managed HSM endpoints will allow mTLS from our nodes. I'll prepare DPA + subproc attestation pack. Need customer legal contact.

ralph-pricing: POC inputs from AE: baseline 7 qps, spikes to 35 qps, avg 120 tokens/request, model: 7B quant, 30 day POC. Ballpark costs:
- HOSTED+GEO_PIN: ~$2.4k/mo + one-time networking ~$3k
- DEDICATED EU: ~$8.2k/mo + onboarding ~$2k
- PRIVATE EU CONTROL PLANE: ~$16k/mo + integration SOW ~$6k (lead time 3-6w)
BYOK-HSM SOW: ~$4k-7k depending on HSM vendor.

jeva-ml: Perf note: 7B quant should keep median token latency sub-200ms at these QPS with small batching; include P95 estimates in the brief.

jo-ops: Ops caveat: hosted+BYOK requires outbound connectivity to HSM; if customer firewall blocks that, Private or a connector in customer VPC required. Also plan fallback: agreed maintenance windows or fail-closed policy.

alex: Action items: @ralph prepare one-pager decision matrix, @jo-ops ops checklist + network runbook, @nina-legal subproc export + DPA draft, @eva-ml perf appendix. I'll coordinate with AE and schedule a 20m handoff tomorrow 10:00 CET.

ralph-pricing: Will deliver one-pager by EOD.

nina-legal: Will deliver subproc pack by EOD pending customer contact.

jo-ops: I'll post network diagram and test plan in this thread when ready.

alex: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
